answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The forge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the karst is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the bridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
